author: ETA PRIME
description:
NZXT just dropped the H2 Flow, a brand-new small form factor case—and I went hands-on to build a Mini-ITX 1440p gaming PC inside it.
Big airflow, removable panels, a PCIe riser, and room for a 280mm AIO + triple-slot 330mm GPU… in an SFF build.

Learn More About The NZXT H2 Flow: https://nzxt.com/?utm_source=etaprime&utm_medium=influencer&utm_campaign=h2_launch
Core Ultra 265K: https://ebay.us/X1YwLM
Mini ITX B860 Motherboard: https://ebay.us/Wu3rUD
DDR5: https://ebay.us/GWolfz
RX 9060Xt: https://ebay.us/62J0tV
280X: https://amzn.to/4kFblnd
NZXT Kraken Elite 280: https://amzn.to/4kHziu6

In this build, I’m pairing an Intel Core Ultra 7 265K (20C/20T) with the ROG Strix B860-I Gaming WiFi, cooling it with the NZXT Kraken Elite 280 RGB (LCD display + CAM customization), and dropping in the Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB (ASUS Prime) to see what kind of real-world 1440p performance we can get.

This Budget PC Plays Everything You Need! (Without Going Broke)
